paragraphs: Salamander sells accountability software that brings TAG, TRACK, and REPORT together as one integrated solution for managing events and day-to-day activity. The pages say the company provides businesses, organizations, and emergency management with tools to manage small and large events as well as ongoing day-to-day activity. Salamander states that resources can be accounted for with or without internet, and it also offers manual accountability products including cards, collection boards, and worksheets.

SalamanderLive is a cloud-based application for managing people, equipment, plans, and events from anywhere with internet connectivity. Its event features include an interactive ICS Chart, satellite map imagery with plotted resource locations, rostering, and a Resource Timer tied to an EVENTS PRO or PLANS subscription. Scans are verified against SalamanderLive through SALAMANDER IDENTIFICATION VERIFICATION, also known as SIV, to confirm that people entering the scene are active, vetted, and qualified.

Mobile apps for Android and iOS devices let personnel check in and out of an event, scan TAGs for on-scene accountability, and conduct PAR in the field. PC based applications include RAPID TAG EVAC, which creates evacuee IDs that track location, destination, special needs, and family connections. Those applications are described as deployed and proven on events by Salamander customers nationwide.

quote.text: Salamander links physical with digital, providing information to assure everyone goes home at the end of the day.
